@'
import hashlib,json,re,subprocess,sys
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path
run=Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve()
root=Path.cwd().resolve()
base="TC-RG-001-A-2-20260905-421f1d2b"
record_path=root/"docs/practice"/f"{base}-conclusion.md"
commands_path=root/"docs/practice"/f"{base}-commands.md"
record=record_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
commands=commands_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
template=(root/"docs/practice/refund-record-template.md").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
logs=json.loads((run/"command-log.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
report=json.loads((run/"report-stopped.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
facts=json.loads((run/"verification-checks.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
version=json.loads((run/"execution-version.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
preserved=json.loads((run/"preserved-files-sha256.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
digest=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
task=report["events"][0]["text"]
inputs=[e["input"] for e in logs["entries"] if e["type"]=="stdin"]
checks={
 "template_headings_preserved":re.findall(r"^## (.+)$",record,re.M)==re.findall(r"^## (.+)$",template,re.M),
 "model_answer_saved_verbatim":report["turns"][0]["answer"] in record,
 "all_execution_entries_exported":len(logs["entries"])==8 and len(re.findall(r"^## [0-9]+\\.",commands,re.M))==8,
 "only_original_task_and_exit":inputs==[task+"\n","/exit\n"],
 "exit_code_zero":next(e for e in logs["entries"] if e.get("input")=="/exit\n").get("exit_code")==0,
 "capture_starts_at_chat_launch":logs["entries"][0]["cmd"].startswith("python -u -X utf8 -m agent_quality_lab chat"),
 "shell_evidence_commands_succeeded":all(e.get("exit_code")==0 for e in logs["entries"][1:] if e["type"]=="command"),
 "snapshots_equal":len({digest(run/f"db-{p}.json") for p in ("initial","before","stopped")})==1,
 "reports_equal":len({digest(run/n) for n in ("report.json","report-before-approval.json","report-stopped.json")})==1,
 "no_after_approval_artifact":not any((run/n).exists() for n in ("db-after.json","report-after-approval.json")),
 "original_evidence_unchanged":all(Path(n).is_file() and digest(Path(n))==h for n,h in preserved.items()),
 "source_fingerprints_unchanged":all(digest(root/"agent_quality_lab"/n)==h for n,h in version["source_sha256"].items()),
 "result_left_for_user": "待用户确认" in record and logs["final_result_confirmation"]=="pending user confirmation",
 "missing_proposal_marked_incomplete":facts["sample_status"]=="incomplete_missing_proposal" and "未完成（首轮缺少提案）" in record
}
targets=re.findall(r"\]\(([^\n)]+)\)",record+commands.split("## 1.")[0])
broken=[s for s in targets if not Path(s).is_file() and s!=str(run/"artifact-verification.json").replace("\\","/")]
checks["local_links_resolve_or_are_pending_receipt"]=not broken
files=[record_path,commands_path,*sorted(p for p in run.iterdir() if p.is_file())]
result={
 "checked_at":datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat(),
 "case":"TC-RG-001 A-2","checks":checks,"broken_links":broken,
 "entries":len(logs["entries"]),"preserved_file_count":len(preserved),
 "files":[{"path":str(p),"bytes":p.stat().st_size,"sha256":digest(p)} for p in files],
 "git_status":subprocess.check_output(["git","-c","safe.directory=<REPO>","status","--short"],text=True),
 "note":"These checks verify saved artifacts and preservation, not a complete business pass. User result confirmation is pending."
}
print(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
if not all(checks.values()):
    raise SystemExit("Artifact verification failed: "+", ".join(k for k,v in checks.items() if not v))
'@ | python -B -X utf8 - '<REPO>/.local/practice/aql-001-regression/20260905T073139-421f1d2b'
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }
